This document is for the purpose of plotting for the whole genome assembly of S. plana. All other analysis has been conducted in Galaxy.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r packages-auto, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Install and load packages
pacman::p_load(
  
  
  # Data import, export, and wrangling
  janitor, openxlsx, readxl, tidyverse, writexl, yaml, GGally,
  
 
  # Plots
  corrplot, ggpubr, scales, viridis, viridisLite, patchwork,ggVennDiagram, UpSetR, imager,
  

  # Utilities 
  beepr, ccl, cli, crayon, glue, here) 

# Prevent masking of `dplyr` functions by other packages
filter <- dplyr::filter
recode <- dplyr::recode
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r load-images, }
GSM001 <- load.image("input/GSM001 map DeGenies.png")
#GSM002 <- 

plot(GSM001)

```

Plot one on top of the other, then save 
```{r save}
degenies <- (GSM001/GSM002)+
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")

ggsave("output/degenies stacked.png", 
       degenies, 
       device = png,
       dpi = 300)
```
